title: Hopper FP8 selector guards, calibration audit, and stability metrics
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Background: We continue to observe intermittent accuracy regressions and latency spikes when enabling FP8 (E4M3/E5M2) selector profiles on Hopper GPU pools. Failures are most common for long-sequence workloads and across models with skewed activation distributions. This ticket scopes engineering work to add runtime selector safeguards, an offline calibration audit pipeline, and new stability metrics to make enablement measurable and rollback-safe.
proposal: 1) Implement runtime selector "guards" that block E4M3/E5M2 activation when per-request signals exceed safe thresholds (per-sequence kv-cache variance, token-level dynamic range, or quantization scale anomalies). 2) Build an offline calibration audit that runs nightly across a representative corpus and computes per-model signatures. 3) Add a stability metric (Calibration Fragility Index - CFI) and integrate it into Console alerts and rollout gating. 4) Add deterministic synthetic stress CI jobs that exercise long sequences, temperature extremes, and prefix cache reuse to catch drift early.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime selector guard prevents switching to FP8 for requests with KV variance > configured threshold and logs a clear telemetry reason code
Nightly calibration audit runs for top-25 models and saves historical calibration signatures for at least 30 days
CFI computed and surfaced in Console per-model: shows baseline, daily delta, and a 95th percentile tail signal
Synthetic stress CI catches at least one previously-observed regression (reproduces failure mode) in pre-submit runs
Canary rollout plan defined and validated: auto-fallback to INT8 on CFI > 0.15 or accuracy delta > 0.8%
Automated PRs to rollback FP8 profile for flagged models are generated when audit fails the gating rules
tasks: Design selector guard heuristics and threshold model with Research (owner: Liam)
Implement guard hooks in serving runtime and expose debug telemetry (owner: runtime team)
Create nightly calibration audit pipeline (owner: infra / data-team)
Define and implement CFI metric calculation + Console visualization (owner: console)
Add synthetic stress CI jobs and integrate into OSS CI matrix (owner: qa)
Write runbook for investigation and rollback (owner: SRE)
Coordinate security review for telemetry and KMS usage (owner: security)
End-to-end integration test between audit pipeline and rollout automation (owner: platform)
Postmortem template for any calibration-related incidents (owner: reliability)
testing_plan: Unit tests for guard logic including corner cases (all zero KV, extremal scales)
Integration test validating fallback from FP8 to INT8 under simulated drift
Nightly audit results compared against baseline; generate synthetic drift to validate alerting
Manual QA on selected models with long-context and cache reuse patterns
Canary release to Dedicated Hopper pool with 1% traffic for 48h; monitor CFI and accuracy evals
rollout_plan: Stage 1: Deploy guard and telemetry in staging; run audit pipeline for 72h (no traffic routing changes)
Stage 2: Canary enable FP8 for internal test accounts (1% traffic) with auto-fallback to INT8
Stage 3: Expand to selected customers who opt-in; keep audit and CFI gating active
Stage 4: Full enablement gated by 14-day stability window and zero critical alerts
monitoring_and_alerts: CFI > 0.15 triggers SEV3 alert to platform on-call
Model-level accuracy delta > 0.5% triggers automatic canary rollback
Excessive FP8 guard activations (>10/min across cluster) triggers paging
Nightly audit failure with >3 models failing gate opens incident ticket and generates rollback PR
comments: 2025-01-09 - Aisha Kapoor: Triage - several customer incidents traced to opportunistic FP8 activation on long-context paths. Proposing selector guards and audit. Assigned to Liam for design.

2025-01-11 - Liam O'Connor: Initial design review completed with Research. Proposed three guard heuristics (kv-variance, scale-spike, prefix-reuse-skew). Research to supply baseline thresholds by model family.
2025-01-14 - Runtime team: Spike implemented for guard hook; canary telemetry emitted as 'fp8_guard_reason' with codes. Needs QA harness for synthetic extreme sequences.

2025-01-17 - QA: Synthetic CI job reproduced a long-context regression when guard threshold was too permissive. Recommended tightening kv-variance threshold and adding 0.01 hysteresis for on/off flapping.
2025-01-20 - PM (Daniel Ruiz): Approved canary rollout plan contingent on nightly audit coverage of top-25 models and Console visualization for CFI.
2025-01-22 - Security: Telemetry schema approved subject to PII review and KMS usage for saved calibration artifacts. Security review ticket opened for follow-up.
